Male adventurers and students you pick up in Sunrise Falls tavern had the wrong underwear.  You will need to start a new game to give those characters the right underwear sprite, or just keep their clothes on.

Fixed transitions into and out of Candle Keep.  Still need to connect Candle Keep's world gate to the next zone.

Edit:  Also just now fixed a bug where if you talked to Hari at night, the nighttime lighting and NPCs were still outside in the morning.

notes.title: Monthly update, December: final touches before Early Access
notes.notes:
2018 was a huge year for us.  In January we started the first town of the game.  And in December we're putting on the final touches before we head into Early Access next month.

One of our concerns was that the Shadowlands didn't feel otherworldly enough and we've been thinking of ways to fix that.  The fog and particle effects you see below are part of our solution.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/4eaa75904b2f1cfec0a18c69526fa72ecd69a3a3.jpg[/img]

We also added some new visual elements to tell the player "We're not in Kansas anymore."

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/bb070f2f6c12ea5234253731e14187ed937f96a0.jpg[/img]

Catching up to our heroes as they push the plot along, we fight our way into the Northern Shores, breaking a truce that had held for decades.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/d4bc740fdde210ebc5b1dc17e271e155ebdf035f.jpg[/img]

At the gates of Candle and Sword Keeps, you finally defeat the last of your enemies ... Or do you?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/f0ee960383a1318f9ac052aa459d616a53d42d6f.jpg[/img]

When you enter the gate of Candle Keep, you enter the final chapter of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/0f49e0c445e3d6a6e195459ec9b3f166f7c57ca2.jpg[/img]

We promised a plot worthy of a JRPG classic, so of course the game isn't going to end with the defeat of the obvious enemy.  We have a lot of fun in store for you, and we'll try to update you on the progress of the game without giving away too much detail of late-game plot twists.

As we push ahead with our Early Access release next month, we will continue adding content to the game.  Most importantly, we will add more NPCs to the towns, more combat maps, increasingly difficult enemies to fight, and increasingly powerful equipment for your own characters.  We will also start scripting the encounters that push the plot along, making the game something much more than just a series of battles.

That's it for now.  We hope you all enjoyed your holiday season.  And all of us would like to wish you a happy new year.  We'll see you in January.

notes.title: Monthly update, November: Roughing out the rest of the world. Plus a release timeline!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  Here is our monthly update for November.  This was a rough month due to illness and some other complications, but we are still working hard and making progress.  Here is what we worked on this month.

We spent most of the month finishing the last few major regions, with a few required towns, buildings, and rooms.  These are the final regions that will take us to the end of the game.  They are finished and accessible in the game.  Next we need to populate these areas with vendors, townsfolk, enemies, and battle maps.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/629910823728ccb3825edd9377b37ee5b6472f66.jpg[/img]

Last month, we left our heroes in the Icy Reach. This month we added building interiors to the city.  Here is the throne room of the Icy Reach.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/5c08eb8d2508682286e186f568275974e1684c29.jpg[/img]

The library at the Icy Reach will contain information critical to your quest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/1561400bf1de1ae7f7a13365b4f14c98d4c84864.jpg[/img]

When you have finished exploring the Icy Reach, head through the world gate.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/859dfe979a8db59bd7b7bcb2430773c70b7b214b.jpg[/img]

When you emerge from the world gate, you find yourself somewhere in the Shadowlands again.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/836e153b13185d6b3bfc84fbc3b5c1a768ccf923.jpg[/img]

The Shadowlands are more dangerous than ever.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/1cf34c85a7013949b23447f6fe0bde6caa6e239a.jpg[/img]

At Utakawa Outpost, you can return to Yamatai lands, where old alliances will be broken and new alliances forged.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/28751878d3fd5d6da420fac65bcb5a6c9d57537c.jpg[/img]

The city of Utakawa lies on the other side of the world gate.  Getting these new Japanese-style buildings ready for the game took no small amount of time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/82866757d532dc78e24763fc76c6b8d89833dc1c.jpg[/img]

Not shown here are the many smaller buildings we added this month, and the actual final regions of the game:  the Northern Shores, Candle and Sword Keep, and the Crypt of the Weeping God.  Those areas are almost done, but not quite ready to show as of the end of November.  Once those areas are done, we'll start populating the new areas with NPCs, enemy encounters, and battle maps.

The game isn’t quite ready for release yet, but we are close enough to the end that we feel confident being able to tell you our timeline.  We hope to have all of the regions fully playable by the end of January when we will begin selling the game as an Early Access title on Steam.

Due to some missed milestones early on in development, we had to redistribute our soundtrack budget instead of holding onto it and losing much of it to taxes.  We hope to use proceeds from Early Access sales to pay for more original compositions to use in the game and to share with our Kickstarter Digital Deluxe backers, to whom we still owe a download of our original score.

We also hope to use Early Access proceeds to help finish sprite sheets for the highest-tier weapons, plus several new enemy types.  Pixel art is time-consuming, and it is a necessary element of the game that could be contracted out.  Nathaniel has been spending a lot of time on pixel art for the last two years, but with some additional money to hire more pixel artists, Nathaniel can focus on other tasks and we can finish the game faster.

We plan on keeping the game in Early Access until the game is fully playable start to finish; in a world populated with interesting characters; with new weapons, armor, enemies, and crafting recipes to be found in each area you explore; with a moving original score; with a solid plot expounded through cutscenes; and with all Kickstarter backer cameos inserted into the game.  That’s too much to finish by the end of January.  But the game has come along far enough that we should be able to get it presentable by then.  And with some Early Access sales we hope we can finish the game faster and deliver Himeko Sutori version 1.0 sometime in 2019.

So that’s our plan.  Thank you everyone for your continuing support for Himeko Sutori.  We will be back with more news next month.

notes.title: Monthly update, October: New maps taking us into the endgame
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  Here is the monthly update for Himeko Sutori, October 2018.

We decided to try a new development philosophy this month.  Whereas before we tried to deliver small, highly polished levels each month, we are now trying to block out large sections of the game and then adding detail later.  With this new approach we are trying to get the game fully playable from start to finish as fast as possible.

We think this approach was very successful, and we'd like for you to take a look for yourselves:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/c308273f1ee1712bf82d4092546437cfcdbaea7c.jpg[/img]
We last left our heroes waiting on the other side of this portal.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/db140732197319e1e4ee7a55b75235c0346972fd.jpg[/img]
And now we set off on another trek through the dangerous Shadowlands.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/896b7929720181feddfe29154d8b07655ca45ae2.jpg[/img]
We make our way to South Point Crossing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/75d65f771cdeffd49007ff1d8c04977ce8c47e96.jpg[/img]
And through the next gate, we find ourselves in an entirely new environment.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/0f542eb9d3c69f2067d3baaf6e0b869a318462f8.jpg[/img]
There will be many new adventures waiting for you out in the snow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/ddc39d16d947e82248ffa11f0735e9ede04cfeaf.jpg[/img]
The spires of the Icy Reach will be the staging area for your ultimate assault against the Scholars of Candle and Sword.

The areas we've shown you here will be fully traversable in-game as soon as we upload the next patch.  The towns lack shops and NPCs, and we have not yet added unique battle maps for the new zones.  But the hardest and most time-consuming work is out of the way.  Next month we will rough-in the final areas of the game.  And then we begin adding the required detail, including new battle maps, shops, NPCs (including the NPCs and recruitable heroes named after our backers), and the dialog and cutscenes to move the story along.

Along the way we will also keep adding new equipment and crafting recipes.  We have finished the first few tiers of all the weapons and armor, and we are finally starting to create the most powerful weapons to be found.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/c70b063448c7cd580f7e2d3d3076cea6fdac7c89.jpg[/img]
Here is a small preview of some of the more powerful equipment you'll find.

Development on Himeko Sutori is taking much more time and effort than I ever imagined, but it is moving slowly towards completion.  From here, we think we can see light at the end of the tunnel.  It has been a pleasure working on Himeko Sutori for you.  We look forward to handing you the finished product.

That's all for now, but we will be back next month with more updates.  Take care.  And thank you for your ongoing support for Himeko Sutori.

notes.title: Monthly update, September: new maps, new encounters, and underwear
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  Here's what we've been up to in September.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/05a7b9dd8a73f0f1bc19d65da7104271020b0dab.jpg[/img]

We added lots of cool new maps and special encounters to the game.  The new special encounters on the map put less strain on your processor than having a bunch of enemies on the world map, so more special encounters means more adventure with higher framerates.

With the recent changes to Steam's allowed content, developers now have to mark the content of their game very carefully.  When you remove your characters' armor, they were naked, and we marked our game as containing nudity.  That completely changed Himeko Sutori's list of similar games, and it was company we would rather not be in.  So we decided to cover up the characters with some underwear when you take their clothes off.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/ccd8881b8b618181e91a3cfd284b988c744e52d9.jpg[/img]

Characters from saved games prior to this change may have the wrong underwear sprite.  For a while we even had slimes wearing bras and panties.  Those issues should be mostly fixed now.

You can read about more changes in detail over at our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1682757416/himeko-sutori-a-turn-based-tactical-japanese-style/posts/2302257]Kickstarter page[/url].

We're cranking out more content as fast as we can and we hope to have a full game ready for you to play very soon.  Thank you very much for your interest in Himeko Sutori.  We'll share more news with you next month.

notes.title: Monthly update, August: New trailer and screenshots, plus hats!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.  We have a new trailer!  There was an older trailer we had on our storefront for about nine months.  We figured it was time for an update.  We could tell you more about it, but it would be faster for you to just watch it for yourselves.  We hope you like it.

Taking a look at our Steam build history, it looks like we uploaded 27 patches during the month of August.  And we have one more that we're going to try to push out today.  We fixed tons of bugs this month, thanks to the help of one very dedicated tester.  We're not opening up the game for Early Access just yet.  If one tester found that many bugs, we would probably drown in bug reports from many testers.

For now at least we can say that the game is much more fixed than it was a month ago.  It's smaller and faster and now playable through about 6 hours of content.

Speaking of content reminds us:  there are now hats in the game! 
 Here's a test level showing off some of the 30+ hats and helmets in the game so far.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/8ceb8b12de8fea73cf38091fdefe720ae36850b4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/37aac52029cb9474411df3b69a505570b8890f39.jpg[/img][/url]

There are helmets that add defense, wizard hats that increase spell power, and crowns that increase leadership.  There are top hats, goggles, miters, hoods, masks, and more, all with unique stats and sprite sheets.

We're going to keep adding more content to the game, and hopefully we'll have a release date to announce to you soon.  For now, please add Himeko Sutori to your wishlist if you haven't done so already, and you'll get notified when the game is ready.

We'll be back next month with more news.

notes.title: Monthly update, July: new desert area with new battle maps, towns, and factions
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  There's still almost a week left in July, but something came up and I might be gone for a few days, so I wanted to post this to make sure I don't skip a month.

Those of you who have been playing our test builds know that we last saw our heroes as they stepped through their second world gate.  We have now built the area behind that gate.

The Ittihad al-Janub is a land of harsh desert and lush oases.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/586ff14ac90ec0749faa1fec8c5dfc4106bd0f74.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/cb62ffe7e315a4029280a6de48fa1a9a60ec2e2c.jpg[/img]

Beneath the sands you'll find vast treasures jealously guarded by the ancient pharaohs and their servants.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/3a6dfcc37325bda218c16941b95bf8b81d0fd221.jpg[/img]

You'll also fight the Scrappers with their mechanical creations.  And you might pick up some useful schematics and spare parts from them.  You'll explore new towns, make new friends, and fight new enemies.

Before the end of the month I hope to post the next update including all of the latest content and bug fixes.  And then you can start exploring the Ittihad for yourself.  I'll get that patch up as soon as I get back.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31212866/97eb241f2ffadad1901358fb448dfdd2e2c5c2ce.jpg[/img]
